title: Packet Input
text: Read binary data or a CAN message from a communication channel, 5 outputs, {Block output data types} sets Output type and grouping of data from the packet; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Packet identifier} sets the identifier of the packet, {Extended identifier}, {Input packet size} sets the number of bytes that each input packet, {Input packet field byte order} sets the byte order of packet acquired from device Little, {Show “Data Ready” port} adds port Data Ready that signals 1 when data, {Show “Data Error” port} adds port Data Error that signals 1 if error and {Show packet timestamp port} adds port Timestamp that outputs CAN message. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Output Data
ports.summary: Data received from communication channel vector

params.name: Install new board
params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Extended identifier
params.values: Extended identifier of the packet (CAN boards only) ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Input packet size
params.values: Number of bytes that each input packet contains 32 (default) | integer

params.name: Block output data types
params.values: Output type and grouping of data from the packet ’4*double’ (default) | character vector | cell array of character vector

params.name: Input packet field byte order
params.values: Byte order of packet acquired from device Little Endian (default) | Big Endian

params.name: Show “Data Ready” port
params.values: Add port Data Ready that signals 1 when data is available ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Show “Data Error” port
params.values: Add port Data Error that signals 1 if error occurs ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Show packet timestamp port
params.values: Add port Timestamp that outputs CAN message timestamps ’off’ (default) | ’on’
